_comment: GoWild! pass rules, researched 2026-08-17 from Frontier PR/news/community sources. Verify against your pass's current terms - the program changes every pass year.

bookingWindow.domesticNote: Domestic GoWild fares become bookable the day before departure (Eastern time).
bookingWindow.earlyBookingCharge: During 2026 promo periods Frontier sells an Early Booking Charge (from $29, up to ~$99 on peak dates; pin to your pass's published terms) to book beyond the normal 1-day/10-day windows.

fareFeesUSD.notes: Base fare $0.01/segment + taxes/fees. The TSA September 11 fee ($5.60) applies per one-way trip, NOT per segment; extra segments add airport facility charges (~$4-10 each). So a domestic nonstop runs ~$15 and a one-stop ~$20-30. International runs ~$60-110+ per direction.

peakDayCharge: 2026 change: blackout dates are no longer absolute - a Peak Day Charge (from $79, up to ~$159; pin to your pass's published terms) lets you fly on blackout dates.

blackoutDates.label: New Year's 2027 (VERIFY - published list is calendar-2026 only)
MLK weekend 2027 (VERIFY against your pass's current terms)
Presidents Day 2027 (VERIFY against your pass's current terms)

blackoutNote: Frontier's published blackout list covers calendar 2026; passes valid into 2027 (Fall & Winter through Feb 28 2027, Annual through Apr 30 2027) will get additional 2027 dates. The 2027 entries above are conservative guesses - verify against your pass terms.
inventoryReleaseNote: GoWild seats for a date are community-reported to release around midnight Eastern the day before - unofficial and not guaranteed; same-day booking also works while inventory lasts.
connectionRules: Connecting itineraries ARE allowed (published Frontier connect city pairs only), subject to GoWild seat availability on every segment; each segment is $0.01 + its taxes/fees. Returns are booked separately once their own window opens.
feesNotes: Bags and seat assignments are NOT included - pay at booking or bring a free personal item only.
programNotes: 2026 GoWild Fall & Winter Pass launched Aug 4, 2026 at $199 intro, valid through Feb 28, 2027.
2026-27 Annual Pass early-access pricing $299-$349 (regular $599), pass year May 1, 2026 - Apr 30, 2027.
GoWild fares only render on flyfrontier.com when logged into a Frontier Miles account holding an active pass - no public fare filter exists.

searchLinks.notes: The dd1 param wants a 'Aug 18, 2026'-style date (the agent formats this for you). Log in with the GoWild pass on your account, then GoWild fares appear as a fare option when available.
